justification: Inspected byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java-gradle-api/org/gradle/work/{Incremental.java,InputChanges.java,FileChange.java,ChangeType.java,package-info.java} plus byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/{ByteBuddyTask.java,IncrementalResolver.java}. The package is a small Gradle-API shim: its only non-JDK dependencies are org.gradle.api.file.Directory and org.gradle.api.provider.Provider, and it is directly used by only a few classes (ByteBuddyTask, IncrementalResolver, and one test). The observed dependency fan-out is limited and there is no evidence that org.gradle.work depends on a less stable internal package than itself.
